Create All Metadata Data Sets

Source: R/y_create_md.R
create_md.Rd

Converts a mighty_study or mighty_domain object into all four metadata data sets at once, as a convenience wrapper around create_md_table(), create_md_col(), create_md_param() and create_md_values().

Usage

create_md(x)

Arguments

x

A mighty_study or mighty_domain object.

Value

A named list of tibbles:

mdtable

Table definitions, see create_md_table()

mdcol

Column definitions, see create_md_col()

mdparam

BDS parameter definitions, see create_md_param()

mdvalues

Value level definitions, see create_md_values()

See also

mighty_study, create_md_table(), create_md_col(), create_md_param(), create_md_values()

Examples

study <- mighty_study(
  path = system.file("examples", package = "mighty.metadata")
)
create_md(study)
